name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render, descriptor=inventory_item_grid). Accurately describes the function: renders the 8-slot inventory grid for a runtime character into a destination pixel buffer. No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed by callers fd2_inventory_grid_input_step (redraws grid each input step) and fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in (renders grid into status panel).
purpose: Render the 8-slot inventory grid for runtime_char[char_idx] into dst_buf, packing non-empty slots into a 4-column x 2-row grid, with the slot at highlight_slot drawn with a highlighted name border.
logic_summary: Iterates slots 0..7 of runtime_char[char_idx].inventory_slots. Empty slots (bSlot_flag bit7 set) are skipped without advancing active_slot_count. For each present slot it computes grid cell position from active_slot_count (col=count/4, row=count%4; col_x=col*0x96+0x2A, row_y=row*0x16), fetches the 23-byte item-effect record via fd2_get_item_effect_entry(bItem_id), and blits: (1) a background icon sprite chosen by item type (type<0x15 weapon=0x3B, <0x20 armor/shield=0x3C, else other=0x3D; +3 if equipped per slot_flag bit6); (2) the item name label (page=bItem_id+0xB5) with a highlighted border sprite 0xC9 when the RAW slot index == highlight_slot else 0xCD; (3) a value-label sprite plus a 3-digit value depending on type/subtype (weapon->0x40, value=int16 at item+1; armor->0x41, value=int16 at item+5; consumable type 0x20 sub 5 ->0x42 / sub 0xB ->0x43, value=int16 at item+0xE; unrecognized->placeholder dot sprite 0x29 with no number). active_slot_count is incremented for every present slot including the unrecognized path.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_inventory_item_grid(uint32 char_idx, int highlight_slot, uint32 dst_buf)

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the character whose inventory is rendered.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime_char array index; no address residue. Matches sibling renderers in this file (char_idx).

params.name: highlight_slot
params.semantics: Raw inventory slot index (0..7) to draw with the highlighted name border; -1 = no slot highlighted. Compared against the RAW slot iterator, not the packed active_slot_count.
params.reason: Accurate: callers pass the menu cursor index (fd2_inventory_grid_input_step) or -1 (fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in). No address residue.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination pixel-buffer base address (0x140-stride surface). Callers pass either 0xA0000 (live VGA) or an off-screen 320x200 workspace.
params.reason: Accurate destination buffer name; no address residue. Ghidra types it void* but src uses uint32 base address arithmetic consistently with sibling renderers.

returns.semantics: No return value; renders into dst_buf as a side effect.

notes: Clean function: name, all 3 params, and the existing src comment block (lines 404-446) are already correct, ASCII, and precise. Source comment and Ghidra plate are mutually consistent (same logic, type categories, sprite indices, offsets, and the unrecognized-path active_slot_count note), so neither was modified. The @ 0x184c0 annotation in the src comment is allowed (annotation, not a symbol name). Only globals read are the three runtime/sprite/text pointers; nothing written. No logic/equivalence concerns found.
